description.value: Canco is an Esso-branded gas station and convenience store on Tranquille Road in Kamloops. For touring cyclists passing through the north end of Kamloops, it offers a roadside stop with convenience store supplies. The combination of fuel sales and a convenience shop is typical of this chain format.
